heading.en: How does an insect walk on water?

objectives.en: Define surface tension and surface energy
Use the angle of contact and excess pressure

narration.en: A pond skater stands on water without sinking, and a carefully placed needle floats. The surface of water behaves like a stretched skin.
narration.kn: ನೀರಿನ ಕೀಟ ಮುಳುಗದೆ ನೀರಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ, ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಇಟ್ಟ ಸೂಜಿ ತೇಲುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀರಿನ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಎಳೆದ ಪೊರೆಯಂತೆ ವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Molecules at a liquid surface have extra energy because they have fewer neighbours. Surface tension S is the force per unit length along a line on the surface, S = F/l, and it also equals the surface energy per unit area. Its unit is N m⁻¹. A liquid tries to make its surface as small as possible, which is why free drops are spherical. Detergents lower S.
body.kn: ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯ ಅಣುಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಎಳೆತ S = F/l, ಇದು ಏಕಮಾನ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣದ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಶಕ್ತಿಗೂ ಸಮ. ಏಕಮಾನ N m⁻¹. ಹನಿಗಳು ಗೋಳಾಕಾರ; ಮಾರ್ಜಕಗಳು S ಅನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: A molecule deep inside a liquid is pulled equally on all sides. A molecule at the surface is pulled only sideways and inwards, so the surface has extra energy.
Surface tension is the force per unit length along a line in the surface. It also equals the surface energy per unit area.
The angle of contact decides the shape of the surface. Water wets clean glass, theta less than 90 degrees; mercury does not, theta more than 90 degrees.
The pressure inside a drop is more than outside by 2S over r. A soap bubble has two surfaces, so the excess is 4S over r.
In a thin glass tube, water climbs until the surface tension pull balances the weight of the column.
Water in a tube of radius half a millimetre: S = 0.073, theta about zero. It rises about 3.0 centimetres. A narrower tube gives a higher rise.

title.en: Angle of contact, drops, bubbles and capillary rise

body.en: The angle of contact θ is the angle between the liquid surface and the solid inside the liquid. Water on clean glass has θ < 90° and wets it; mercury has θ > 90° and does not. The pressure inside a drop exceeds the outside by 2S/r; a soap bubble has two surfaces, so 4S/r. In a capillary tube of radius r a liquid rises to h = 2S cos θ/(ρgr); mercury is depressed instead.
body.kn: ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕೋನ θ < 90° ಆದರೆ ದ್ರವ ಗಾಜನ್ನು ತೇವಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹನಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಒತ್ತಡ 2S/r, ಸೋಪಿನ ಗುಳ್ಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 4S/r. ಲೋಮನಾಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಏರಿಕೆ h = 2S cos θ/(ρgr).

points.en: h = 2S cos θ/(ρgr): thinner tube, higher rise
